title: The #1 QB recruit got replaced by his own classmate

slide.small: Same recruiting class. Same NFL team.

lines: The number one quarterback recruit in 2015 lost his NFL job to his own classmate.
Josh Rosen was the top QB in the class.
He broke UCLA's passing record, and Arizona took him tenth overall in 2018.
But he went 43 and 0 in high school, then won the Heisman at Oklahoma.

slide.small: Arizona drafts Kyler. Rosen is traded to Miami.

lines: One year after drafting Rosen, Arizona took Kyler first overall, and traded Rosen to Miami.
Rosen was out of the NFL after 2022, and went to Wharton.
Follow for part two: what happened to the rest of the 2015 class.
